notes: Crowded; man in varsity jacket appears mid-strip and walks into room, faint figures linger behind propped glass leaf.
Group near back wall drifts toward the door mid-strip and figures pass behind the glass; foreground people block the edge, direction hard to judge.
Faces close to the camera block about 7 tiles; grey-haired woman in dark coat walks to the door and is gone by the end.
Blonde in cap goes out behind the glass near the end of row 2; white-beanie person heads to door then a similar figure walks back in; men loiter at the door edge.
Blonde in cap who left last strip walks back in; two women enter together mid-strip; man with bun exits behind the glass; men standing at the door edge early are ambiguous.
Mostly people milling inside; one or two women appear beside the door edge in the last few tiles, origin uncertain.
Group standing in front of the door and a head close to the camera hide the edge; extra dark-haired women appear near the door in rows 2-3 but crossings are not directly seen.
Several men walk from the door toward the camera in rows 2-3 (two in row 2, about three at start of row 3); women with backs to camera drift toward the door at the end, exit not confirmed.
People circulate in front of the door; a tall man appears by the door edge in row 1; faint figure lingers behind the glass in row 2; foreground jacket blocks much of row 3.
Man close to camera blocks all of row 2; by row 3 a couple of new people (blue cap, man in glasses) are standing by the door, crossing not seen.
Curly-haired man in hoodie stands in front of the door edge for rows 2-3; crowd behind him visibly grows but no individual crossing can be seen.
Hoodie man blocks row 1; afterwards a standing crowd fills the door area and no crossing can be made out.
Crowd stands across the door area; older woman in beige jacket heads to the door in row 3 and is not seen after; man in black cap appears facing in around the same time.

Man in black strides out early; woman in long quilted coat carrying a small dog enters; older woman in beige jacket walks back in (left last strip); long grey-haired woman in dark coat goes out; a man in navy sweatshirt stands by the door throughout.

Man in navy sweatshirt stands right at the door edge all minute and hides part of it; two dark-clothed people walk in past him, and the long grey-haired woman from last strip comes back in; white-haired figure waits behind the glass at the end.

Man in striped jacket close to camera hides the door for about 20 tiles; white-haired woman in beige comes in from behind the glass and is hugged in row 1; woman in green beanie and man in black beanie appear near the door at the very end.

Face close to camera covers much of row 2; two young men walk in at end of row 2 and a long-haired woman heads out; older woman in beige stands at the door edge and men in caps hover behind the glass in row 3.

Older woman in beige stands directly in front of the door edge all minute and a jacket near the camera covers several tiles; crowd in the room thickens but only one possible arrival (man on phone, last tile) is discernible.
Older woman in beige still stands in front of the door edge; movement seen is people walking from the room toward the camera, no crossing of the right edge could be made out.

Woman in polka-dot top and later a dark-haired woman with brown bag walk out past the older woman standing at the door; a woman in green jacket appears mid-room in row 1, possibly from the door; near-camera jacket blocks parts of rows 2-3.

Man in cap and navy top comes in during row 1; around the row 2/3 boundary the man in black puffer and beanie, a curly-haired woman, a woman in green beanie and the man in hat and scarf all head to the door and are gone after; older woman in beige still stands at the door edge.
Room nearly empty; older woman in beige stands at the door edge talking with a man in a cap who stays behind the glass.
Older woman in beige stays at the door edge with a man in a cap behind the glass; person in blue coat stands at the left edge only.
Man in blue jacket and cap near the camera turns and walks toward the door in row 2 and is gone the next tile; older woman in beige and man in cap behind glass remain at the door.

Man in cap and navy sweatshirt who had been standing behind the glass walks in toward the camera in row 1 (may be a returning person); he and another man then block the view near the camera for much of rows 2-3.

Woman in grey coat and man in navy sweatshirt stand talking right at the door edge for rows 2-3 without clearly crossing; white-haired figure waits behind the glass; heads near the camera block the second half of row 3.

Man in blue jacket, cap and striped scarf walks in at the end; he resembles the man who left about three minutes earlier (57210). Head near camera blocks a few row-1 tiles; pair at the door edge stays put.

Man close to camera blocks the first 7 tiles; when view clears, new people (dark-haired women in black, a man in black cap) are near the door and then walk toward the camera; exact crossings not seen and count is an estimate.
Man in blue jacket walks toward the door in row 1 and is not seen again; from row 2 on a man with a backpack and a masked woman stand close to the camera and hide the door edge most of the time.
Small group (older woman in beige, women in black, man in navy) stands talking in front of the door edge all minute; striped-jacket man blocks about 6 tiles; no crossing made out.
Older woman in beige and a couple stand at the door edge all minute; a man in dark jacket and cap passes close to the camera heading right in row 1 but his exit is not seen.

Several people pass close to the camera in row 1 (one man in puffer heads toward the door) and a man in brown leather jacket crosses in row 2, directions unclear; two men near the camera block all of row 3.
Two men standing close to the camera hide the door edge for the whole minute; counts are unknown rather than zero.
Row 1 and the start of row 2 are hidden by men near the camera; in the visible part people only move within the room and a man in navy stands by the door edge.

Man in navy stands at the door edge all minute; a long-haired woman in dark coat walks to the door early in row 3 and is not seen after; a man with a backpack reaches the door edge by the last tiles but is still in view.

Man with backpack exits at the start and man in brown leather jacket heads out in row 1 (a man in beanie and denim jacket near him is ambiguous, not counted); a long-haired woman in black enters in row 2, then two women (glasses with cup, bun with puffer) enter together; they block several row-3 tiles.
Man in navy stands at the door edge talking to a white-haired person behind the glass; a man in a cap walks up to them and back toward the camera without crossing.
